scope: development only; separate untouched confirmation required for success
primary_denominator: All64 actual update cases on the eight development source compositions; weak effects remain included and may have measured no-change labels. Eight zero controls reported separately.
selection: Highest actual-update exact measured-category accuracy across all3 epochs; earlier epoch wins ties. No best-seed, best-source-composition or best-axis promotion.
secondary: Per-axis correctness on cases with a measurable non-no-change target; retain denominator. Every source composition, seed, measured label, source-versus-effect mismatch, span, margin, norms and raw profile.

uncertainty.scheme: Crossed resampling of eight source compositions and four initialization seeds, then cases within selected cells; identical draws across all methods. Zero controls excluded from primary bootstrap.
uncertainty.intervals: Pointwise descriptive95% percentile intervals and paired differences; development selection bias not corrected; cannot support final confirmation claim.

thresholds: Original program criteria plus pre-reading direction-dependence and majority checks from training-implementation-plan.json. Development gates guide method selection only; not a strong-positive conclusion.
guards: Require full collection and training integrity audits, complete/dead workers, exact3epoch/204optimizerstep/272case grid, original deadlines, complete baseline/control grids, all source/input/checkpoint/output hashes. Archive source before any remote checkout advance.
artifacts: Preserve complete outputs, all72 development cases, all methods/epochs, exact executed analysis source, report and scientific plot; inspect actual figure after execution. Bootstrap arrays ignored. No reserved predictions or test labels in development report.
test_status: 32 meaningful synthetic tests passed; Ruff clean. Training and analysis code not yet executed on scientific outputs.
